claim_boundary: This is a local admission audit for the next V0-ADT continuum binding. It records why no checked-in provider/cavity combination may be called the no-fit V0 physical continuum. It performs no PCM solve, no QM calculation, no force calculation, and no experimental-solvation or accuracy evaluation.

v0_adt_input.required_continuum_contract: A reciprocal energy-conjugate response with identical atomic identities, geometry, and surface points; independent cavity/solvent provenance; and a smooth-coordinate certificate before a physical V0-ADT binding.

audited_candidates.name: PCMSolverExternalMEPCavityResponse
audited_candidates.positive_boundary: It exposes a fixed-geometry energy-conjugate external-MEP response when PCMSolver MATRIXSYMM=TRUE.
audited_candidates.rejection_boundary: The adapter accepts externally supplied per-atom cavity radii but contains no independent V0 cavity-source record. The existing Route-2 profile is the SMD/PCM research path, whose SMD radii/CDS belong only to the explicit empirical comparator. The provider also lacks the complete same-energy coordinate derivative required for a V0 force/PES claim.

audited_candidates.name: PySCFSWIGPCMResponse
audited_candidates.positive_boundary: It keeps direct, transpose, and energy-conjugate external-MEP responses distinct and exposes a research coordinate-operator VJP.
audited_candidates.rejection_boundary: The constructor requires caller-supplied per-atom cavity radii and therefore supplies no independent no-fit V0 cavity provenance. Existing Route-2 SWIG/ISWIG orientation and active-set investigations remain research controls, not a V0 smooth-cavity admission certificate.

audited_candidates.name: Route2V0DiffuseLocalDielectricOperator
audited_candidates.positive_boundary: It is a reciprocal finite-volume reaction scalar for a supplied smooth occupancy and declared bulk dielectric limit.
audited_candidates.rejection_boundary: It has no source-bound solvent occupancy, cavity/nonpolar functional, stationary auxiliary electronic density, or direct V0-ADT surface-source interface. Its own API labels it a fixed-occupancy reaction block rather than a total-solvation asset.

decision.next_action: Do not select or tune a radius/cavity from an error. Admit a new continuum only after its solvent/cavity inputs and smooth-coordinate evidence are independently source-bound before execution.
